solar_coordinates: Native HDF5 [longitude,latitude], nearest 0.05-degree cell, per inventory phase
wind_conversion: Source mean MW; three-hour duration and distinct inventory phases retained
time_zone: UTC+8, cyclic source weather year at year boundary
spatial_assumption: Original project reference locations retained; generation summed over selected phase locations
candidate_status: Retained planning candidates include planned and under-construction wind projects
solar_capacity_mapping: MWp/dc retains raw MW; MWac converts raw MW * 1.2; unknown is assumed DC and retains raw MW
solar_model_scope: Simplified GHI-proportional resource model using documented PVWatts default engineering parameters. No module efficiency multiplier, temperature model, transposition model, or full PVWatts simulation is applied.

solar_parameter_sources.supports: Default system losses 14%; inverter efficiency separately defaults to 96%; inverter losses are excluded from system losses
PVWatts V8 dc_ac_ratio default 1.2 and inv_eff default 96
DC nameplate power is electrical power at STC; AC inverter rating equals DC nameplate divided by DC/AC ratio; module efficiency defines area rather than another multiplier on nameplate power
GEM retains phase-specific AC/DC/unknown capacity ratings; the unknown-to-DC assignment here is a declared study assumption
